Title: Sucker Spawn
Body (HTML):

Fish it #10 to #14 under an indicator directly below sucker redds; the U.P. window runs into June.

Fish it for: Steelhead, Brown trout, Rainbow trout (resident)

Title: Black Stonefly Nymph
Body (HTML):
The Little Black Stonefly (Allocapnia, Taeniopteryx) is the first insect steelhead see in numbers, peaking late February through April, and Current Works ranks it among Michigan's top five steelhead flies, best on sunny days in clear water. Chuck Hawkins ties it large during spring runoff.

Imitates: Early Black Stonefly

Fish it for: Steelhead, Brown trout, Rainbow trout (resident), Brook trout, Chinook salmon, Coho salmon
